hero.title: Your files stay yours.
hero.subtitle: Files are encrypted on your device before they leave it. We store them — but we can't read them. Nobody can.
hero.priceHook: Cheaper than Google Drive. Built for people who care about their privacy.

features.title: Everything you need. Nothing you don't.
features.subtitle: Secure storage that doesn't make you trade privacy for convenience. Both. Together.

encryption.title: Encrypted before upload
encryption.desc: Your files are locked with AES-256 on your device. By the time they reach our servers, we see only encrypted data.

speed.title: Fast — even encrypted
speed.desc: We optimised the encryption pipeline so uploads feel instant. Security without the slowdown.

storage.title: 4 GB free to start
storage.desc: New users get 4 GB at no cost. No credit card required. Upgrade only when you need more.

sharing.title: Private sharing
sharing.desc: Share files with a time-limited, password-protected link. Recipients get access — nobody else does.

regional.title: Built for Egypt & the region
regional.desc: Local payment methods coming soon: Vodafone Cash, Fawry, and InstaPay. No foreign cards needed.

crossDevice.title: Works everywhere
crossDevice.desc: Access your files from your phone, tablet, or desktop. Everything stays in sync — always encrypted.

howItWorks.title: Simple. Secure. Yours.
howItWorks.subtitle: You don't need to understand encryption to benefit from it. Here's the whole story in three steps.

encrypt.title: Your device encrypts it
encrypt.desc: Before anything is uploaded, your file is locked with a key that only you have. It never leaves your device unencrypted.

store.title: We store it — but cannot see it
store.desc: Your encrypted file is safely stored in our cloud. We have zero access to the content. Not us, not anyone.

access.title: Only you can open it
access.desc: When you want to view your files, your device decrypts them locally. Full access, zero compromise.

howItWorks.trustNoteEnd: — the strongest standard in privacy-first storage.

trust.title: We can't read your files.
trust.titleHighlight: That's not a promise — it's the architecture.
trust.subtitle: Most services say "we protect your privacy." We built a system where protecting it isn't optional — it's the only way the product works.

noAccess.title: We genuinely cannot see your files
noAccess.desc: Not "we promise not to look." We technically cannot. The decryption key lives only on your device — never on our servers.

noAds.title: No ads. No data selling. Ever.
noAds.desc: We make money one way: you pay for storage. That's it. No behavior tracking, no ad targeting, no hidden fees.

ownership.title: Your data belongs to you
ownership.desc: Export everything anytime, in standard formats. No lock-in. If you leave, your files leave with you.

comparison.othersText: Scans your files for ads, trains AI on your content, can hand data to third parties.
comparison.aamennText: Encrypted before upload. We see only random-looking bytes. Peace of mind by design.

comparison.title: Better privacy. Lower price.
comparison.subtitle: Most storage providers make money by scanning your files. We don't — and we still charge less.

encryption.title: End-to-end Encryption
encryption.desc: We do not see your files. Ever.
